description: He wears a dark blue textured wool knee-length long-sleeved tunic with narrow gold knotwork embroidery at the neckline, central front panel, cuffs and hem, a pale linen undertunic visible at neck, wrists and hem, a pair of round bronze clasps linked across the upper chest, a brown leather belt with bronze fittings and hanging strap, brown wool trousers, dark wrapped lower legs and brown leather boots. No armor or weapon is visible.
